name: create_video_from_cinematic_avatar
description:
Create a video from a text prompt plus avatar and asset references (Cinematic Avatar).

Cinematic Avatar generates a video from a natural-language ``prompt`` guided by
reference content: one to three avatar looks and optional reference assets
(images / videos / audio). Unlike the ``avatar`` and ``image`` modes there is
no script or voice — motion and speech are driven entirely by the prompt and
the supplied references. Backed by the Seedance generation pipeline.

prompt.description: Natural-language prompt describing the video to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

avatarId.description: Avatar look ID(s) used as visual references. Provide 1 to 3 look IDs.
avatarId.title: Avatarid

references.description: Reference assets (images, videos, or audio) guiding the generation. Each accepts a URL, an asset_id. Combined limits: at most 3 videos and 9 images across avatars and references.
references.title: References

aspectRatio.description: Output aspect ratio. Supported for cinematic_avatar: '16:9', '9:16', '1:1'. Defaults to '16:9'.
aspectRatio.title: Aspectratio

resolution.description: Output resolution. Supported for cinematic_avatar: '720p', '1080p'. Defaults to '720p'.
resolution.title: Resolution

autoDuration.description: Let the model choose the video length. When true, omit duration.
autoDuration.title: Autoduration

duration.description: Video length in seconds (4–15). Defaults to 10. Omit when auto_duration is true.
duration.title: Duration

title.description: Display title for the video in the HeyGen dashboard.
title.title: Title

AssetId.description: Asset input via HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint.

asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint
asset_id.title: Asset Id

AssetId.title: AssetId

AssetUrl.description: Asset input via publicly accessible HTTPS URL.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the asset
url.title: Url

AssetUrl.title: AssetUrl
